title: Motion-Sensor Night Lights for Hallways and Bathrooms: What to Check Before You Buy
subtitle: A small light that switches on when you walk by can make the trip to the bathroom at night easier, so here is how to compare a few GE Enbrighten models and place them sensibly.
excerpt: Motion-sensor night lights turn on when they sense movement and switch off after a short time with no activity. Here is a plain-English look at three GE Enbrighten models, plug-in and battery, and how to place them.
author: Nickel And Gadget Editors

sections.content: Most of us know the routine. You wake up in the dark, need the bathroom, and either feel your way along the wall or reach for a switch that floods the room with bright light. Neither is ideal, especially in a hallway with a rug or a doorway along the way.

A motion-sensor night light is a simple option. It turns on when it senses movement nearby, so you can see where you are going without reaching for a switch. After a short time with no activity, it turns itself off. The plug-in GE light covered below has no monthly fee, since it is a plain plug-in light.

A motion sensor notices movement and turns the light on. Each light below then turns off after a set time with no activity: 90 seconds for the two plug-in models and one minute for the battery model. The battery model also has light sensing, and the 2-pack plug-in model turns on at dusk and off at dawn.

You will mostly choose between two kinds. Plug-in models go into a wall outlet, so they can only go where there is a free outlet. Battery models can be placed away from outlets, but the batteries will need changing from time to time. The notes we have do not say which batteries the GE battery model uses or how many, so check the product page before you buy.

Brightness is measured in lumens, which is a count of how much light a bulb gives off. The two plug-in models are 40 lumens, which makes them a guide light rather than full room lighting. The battery model is listed as up to 300 lumens.

items: How far it senses motion. The plug-in models here list up to 25 feet.
How long it stays on. If you or your parent walks slowly or sits still for a while, a 90-second or one-minute timer could end while you are still moving about.
Brightness. Check the lumen figure on the package or product page, and remember a plug-in night light only lights the area around its outlet.
Light color. The battery model lists 3000K warm light, and the single plug-in model lists soft white. Check the page for the color of any light you consider.
Outlet fit. The 2-pack plug-in lights leave the second outlet free, which is handy if you use it for a lamp or charger.
Battery needs. For battery models, confirm what batteries it takes before you buy, and plan to change them.
A safety listing. The 2-pack is listed as UL Listed, so look for that on any light you consider.
Return terms. Check the seller's return policy before you buy, in case the light does not suit your space.

sections.content: Below are three GE Enbrighten lights sold at Lowe's. Lowe's shows pricing by store location, so check current price for your area.
Think about the actual path from the bed to the bathroom and walk it once with the lights off. Note where you hesitate. Those are good places to think about putting a light.
One idea is a light near the bedroom door, one partway down the hallway and one in the bathroom. A plug-in light only brightens the area around its outlet, so a long hallway may need more than one.

Stairs need extra care. Many staircases have no outlet nearby, and the battery model's Lowe's page title calls it a Utility Lantern, so check its size on the product page before you consider it near stairs. We cannot say it suits stairs. Whatever you use, keep it where it cannot be knocked off or tripped over, and never set anything on a step.
After setup, try the route at night for a few evenings. Check that each light turns on before you reach it and stays on long enough for you. If one does not suit the spot, move it.

These lights are a guide, not full room lighting, and they are not connected to any alert, so they do not tell family if someone falls. If you or a parent has had falls or feels unsteady at night, talk with a doctor. In an emergency, call 911.
sections.label: Good to Know

sections.content: A few small lights along the way can make the walk to the bathroom easier to see. Start with the darkest spot on the route, see how it feels for a week, and add more from there.

products.name: GE Enbrighten Battery-Operated Motion-Sensing Light (Model 27529)
products.blurb: A portable battery light with up to 300 lumens of 3000K warm light, plus light sensing and motion sensing. It turns off one minute after motion stops; the batteries it needs were not confirmed, and its size should be checked before you place it anywhere near stairs.
